company.name: Funding Souq
company.shortDescription: Funding Souq is an online lending platform that connects investors with established SMEs that are seeking business loans.
company.description: Funding Souq is a digital lending platform that aims to address the $230bn SME funding gap across the MENA region. The platform connects creditworthy borrowers to lenders who will have the opportunity to generate a competitive return by lending to local businesses by adhering to the principles of Islamic Finance.

productsAndServices.description: An online marketplace that connects established SMEs seeking financing with individual and institutional investors who fund business opportunities through debt-based crowdfunding.

productsAndServices.description: A Sharia-compliant business financing service for established SMEs, providing access to capital through an online application and investor-funded financing process.

productsAndServices.description: An investment service that gives retail and institutional investors access to short-term, Sharia-compliant private credit opportunities backed by SME financing transactions.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Seed round raised $2,500,000, or 100% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $3,142,830 to $17,935,419, a 5.71x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 53 (-5 over 90 days) and market heat at 44 (-7).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
